question: A number when divided by 7 leaves a remainder 4. What will be the remainder when the square of the same number is divided by 7?
solution:
**Given:**

A number, when divided by 7, leaves the remainder 4

**Formula Used:**

Dividend=Divisor x Quotient+Remainder

**Calculation:**

According to the question

​⇒ Number=7k+4

​⇒ Let the value of k=1

​⇒ then, number = 7x1+4=7+4=11

​⇒ Square of the Number=11x11=121

The number is divided by 7

​⇒ (Number)/(7)=(121)/(7) = 7 x 17 + 2

​⇒ **Hence, When the square of the same number is divided by 7 then the remainder will be 2**
